Definition: properly, to dash in pieces, i.e. kill (a human being), especially to murder
BiblicalUsage: 1) to murder, slay, kill; 1a)(Qal) to murder, slay; 1a1) premeditated; 1a2) accidental; 1a3) as avenger; 1a4) slayer (intentional) (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be slain; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to murder, assassinate; 1c2) murderer, assassin (participle) (subst); 1d) (Pual) to be killed
